user.title: Home Radio
user.description: Plays the TV app's radio stations and YouTube through a player on this Home Assistant machine (the VLC add-on plays through its speakers).

data_description.target: Usually media_player.vlc from the VLC add-on.
data_description.tv_urls: e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8698 — the station list is read from here whenever the app is running, and remembered.

abort.already_configured: This player is already set up.

play_station.name: Play station
play_station.description: Plays one of the radio stations.

play_youtube.name: Play YouTube
play_youtube.description: Searches YouTube and plays the first result, queueing the rest; or plays a video URL.

url.name: Video URL
url.description: A YouTube video to play (the search, if given, becomes its queue).

search_youtube.name: Search YouTube
search_youtube.description: Returns YouTube results without playing anything.

refresh_stations.name: Refresh stations
refresh_stations.description: Reads the station list from the TV app now.

play_cast.name: Play cast track
play_cast.description: Used by the Home Cast add-on: plays one YouTube video sent from a phone's Cast button. The phone keeps the queue.

position.name: Start position
position.description: Seconds into the track to start from.

play_spotify.name: Play Spotify link
play_spotify.description: Plays a Spotify playlist, album or song (link as shared from the Spotify app) from YouTube. No Spotify account needed; playlists give up to 100 songs.

remove_list.name: Remove saved list
remove_list.description: Removes a saved Spotify list from Home Radio's Lists.

get_list.name: Get saved list
get_list.description: Returns the songs of a saved list (for picking one to start from: play_media with list:<id>@<number>).

set_crossfade.name: Set crossfade
set_crossfade.description: How many seconds one track fades into the next (0 = off).
